author: China Insights
description:
On the surface, the US President’s state visit to Beijing seemed like a masterclass in diplomacy—complete with smiling leaders, firm handshakes, and grand promises of cooperation. But behind the camera and beneath the ironclad security protocols, a silent, high-stakes political battle was being waged.

Reports suggest that host officials deployed a series of subtle "micro-aggressions" and tactical maneuvers targeting the American press corps and the White House Secret Service.

In this episode, we step away from the polished official press releases and put a magnifying glass over the micro-details of this summit, decoding the raw, unscripted friction of superpower geopolitics.
title: The Secret War: Inside Trump’s Beijing Visit & The Death of US-China TrustI China Insights
